title: Token-slab cost allocator: attribute cold/cache/compute latency to token windows
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Our current request-level tracing lumps together prefix/priming, KV-cache hits/misses, and model compute time. This makes it hard to answer: which contiguous token ranges (token slabs) in a response are driving tail latency and incremental compute cost, and how much of that is avoidable via cache-prefetch or batching heuristics.

Goal: Implement a token-slab cost allocator that attributes observed latency and estimated GPU compute cost across contiguous token windows: 'prefill' (model warmup, priming), 'cached' (KV hit-dominated), and 'compute' (cold attention compute). The allocator should surface per-request and aggregated metrics, backfill historical traces into a telemetry pipeline, and power a new dashboard and SLA/billing reconciler.

Scope: instrumentation and server-side tagging (runtime hooks), trace enrichment and event schema, ingestion pipeline changes (metrics and logs), aggregation jobs for SLA attribution, dashboard panels and alert rules. Not in scope: billing chargeback integration and customer-facing cost exports (follow-up work).
acceptance_criteria: Runtime emits token-slab events with fields: slab_id, slab_type (prefill|cached|compute), start_token_index, end_token_index, slab_latency_ms, cache_hit_ratio, model_variant
Trace enrichment pipeline ingests slab events and stores them in the observability DB with <24h latency for production sampling rate
Aggregated views show slab-level p50/p95/p99 latency and estimated token compute seconds per slab for last 7/30/90 days
Dashboard includes example drilldown from a request trace to slab breakdown and a top-20 slab patterns causing p99 tail
Automated test harness validates sampler+enricher correctness against synthetic traces with mixed hit/miss patterns
No regression to request-level throughput on the serving fleet (+/- 2% observed at 95th percentile of test load)
tasks: Define slab event schema and wire contract with runtime (proto/JSON shape)
Add lightweight token-slab hook in serving runtime: emit on slab boundary and on cache-hit/miss transitions
Instrument KV cache to report slab hit ratio and cold-start penalty estimate
Extend tracing agent to attach slab events to existing request trace IDs and span parents
Update ingestion pipeline: new topic, parser, and enrichment lambda to compute derived fields
Build aggregator job for slab-level rollups and retention policy (7/30/90 days)
Create initial Grafana dashboard and alert rules for slab-driven tail latency
Run 2-week canary on staging then controlled rollout to 10% of prod, monitor perf and storage cost
